manual_checks: Test with organization that has limits close to maximum (>90% usage)
Test with organization that has unlimited limits (-1 value)
Test with organization that has low usage (<70%)
Verify all limit types display (categories, products, etc.)
Check loading state appears briefly during data fetch
Verify error handling if data fetch fails
